title: Astrid and the Wolf
author: Orsen Zhou
blurb: Oscar Ishikawa, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
